Ask one multiple-choice question

Usage: jev choice [OPTIONS] <INSTRUCTIONS> [OPTION]...

Arguments:
  <INSTRUCTIONS>
          What the model should decide

  [OPTION]...
          Option as `name` or `name=description` (2 to 255; names unique and non-empty). `--` must
          come after every flag

Options:
      --id <ID>
          Question id
          
          [default: q]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version

State:
  -s, --state <TEXT>
          State text

  -f, --state-file <PATH>
          Read the state from a file (`-` means stdin)

      --state-json
          Parse the state as a JSON object, array or string

Output:
  -o, --output <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Two-decimal blocks for `ask`, or one bare value for a single question
          - json: The response document plus `cost_usd`
          
          [default: text]

      --json
          Shorthand for `--output json`

  -v, --verbose
          After a successful request, print model, tokens, retries and estimated cost on stderr

      --debug
          Print each failed attempt on stderr as it happens

      --dry-run
          Print the request JSON and do not send it. No API key is required

Connection:
      --api-key <KEY>
          API key (`TYPESAFE_API_KEY`). Prefer the environment variable: flags are visible to other
          processes

      --base-url <URL>
          API endpoint (`JEV_BASE_URL`)
          
          [default: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone]

      --model <NAME>
          Model name (`JEV_MODEL`)
          
          [default: jev-latest]

      --timeout <SECONDS>
          Per-request timeout in whole seconds (`JEV_TIMEOUT`), 1 to 86400. Also bounds connecting
          
          [default: 60]

      --retries <N>
          Extra attempts after the first for transient failures (`JEV_RETRIES`)
          
          [default: 8]
